network_policy: No direct network calls or credential reads; use parent-owned authenticated local broker and common collector only.

membership_policy.project_definition: A named initiative/product family with explicit primary implementation, official/dedicated integration, or documented direct initiative membership.
valid_evidence: Canonical implementation under project-maintainer ownership, corroborated by README purpose.
A dedicated SDK/provider/plugin/adapter explicitly built for the named initiative, corroborated by purpose and linkage.
A documented direct project-family component with explicit scope and relationship.
invalid_evidence: Generic tutorial or sample that happens to use a library.
Shared language, framework or storage technology.
Search topic membership, organization ownership or repository name without corroborating purpose.
membership_policy.ground_truth_policy: All collected labels are PROPOSED and require independent human review/adjudication. Record evidence quotes, line ranges, pinned file URLs, contrary evidence, uncertainty and excluded plausible alternatives.
membership_policy.monorepo_policy: A repository ID counts once, regardless of package, integration, directory or language count.
